# Pages agent — task

Scope: every page except the commerce surfaces, plus the trust blocks. Database `protpure_pages`, port **3004**.

**The catalogue agent owns** `/products*`, `/compare`, `/request-quote`, `src/components/product/*`, `src/components/rfq/*`, `src/components/forms/InquiryForm.tsx`, `src/app/(frontend)/products/**`. Do not edit those; keep changes to shared files (`globals.css`, `ui/index.tsx`, `RenderBlocks.tsx`, `cards.tsx`) additive and small.

The homepage and its blocks are done (`src/components/blocks/RenderBlocks.tsx`, `src/seed/data/pages.ts` → `home`); headings may now carry typed line breaks (rendered as breaks) and `*italic*` propositions.

1. **CMS pages** (`src/app/(frontend)/[slug]/page.tsx` + `src/seed/data/pages.ts` for `about`, `technology`, `global-supply`, `privacy`, `terms`): rework their seed layouts as numbered chapters in the homepage idiom. **Technology**: hero with `BeadSchematic` (BUILD-BRIEF item 1), the particle platform (`gradesPlatform` + `RangeBars`), cross-linking/ligand chemistry chapters (`twoColumn`, `featureGrid`), documents. **About**: founder spread (`twoColumn` + `teamGrid` "spread"), milestones (`timeline`), capabilities, customers (`logoWall`), publications, gallery slot. **Global supply**: proof bar, certifications strip, distributor CTA. Facts exactly as in the current seed/CMS; tighten copy only; `pnpm seed` must reproduce it.
2. **Trust blocks** `src/components/blocks/trust/{CertificationsStrip,Gallery,ProofBar,Publications}.tsx`: restyle on the Deep Field tokens: proof bar as a mono-figure row (founded · team · capacity · customers statement · LinkedIn followers from `siteSettings.proof`), certifications strip as rule-separated rows with the kind label in the eyebrow style, publications as a numbered list with journal/year in mono, gallery as the arch-image grid with a `placeholder-slot` only editors (draft mode) see when empty. Use `Chapter`/`ChapterHead` so they number correctly among chapters (add them to `CHAPTER_BLOCKS` when they carry an eyebrow; an empty block hidden from visitors must not consume a number).
3. **Listing and detail routes**: `/applications`, `/applications/[slug]`, `/services`, `/resources` (documents by type with `DocumentRow`, mono file sizes), `/blog`, `/blog/[slug]` (680 px measure, serif display, mono dateline), `/updates` (by `kind`, drafts hidden), `/faq` (category tabs + `FaqList`), `/contact` (address, map link, WhatsApp; quotes route to `/request-quote`), `/newsletter/confirm`, `/newsletter/unsubscribe`, and `src/app/(frontend)/not-found.tsx` (bead field, serif "Nothing here", catalogue/contact links). Each uses `PageHero`/`ListingHero` (extend additively if a variant is missing), the chapter idiom and the new tokens; replace `lucide-react` in files you touch with `src/components/visual/icons.tsx` (add stroke icons there if needed, 24-grid, 1.5 stroke).
4. **`src/components/{PostCard,UpdateCard,FaqList,RichText}.tsx`**: restyle (RichText: serif h2/h3, 680 px measure, mono captions, tables on `.spec-table`).
5. **SEO / AI surfaces**: `src/lib/seo.ts` titles; `/llms.txt`, `/md/*`, `/api/public/*` still 200 and reflecting seed copy changes (`src/lib/markdown.ts` — extend its `switch` for any new block field).

Screenshots at 1440 and 390 for `/about`, `/technology`, `/global-supply`, `/applications`, `/applications/<one>`, `/services`, `/resources`, `/blog`, `/blog/<one>`, `/updates`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/nothing-here` — look at them and fix what is wrong before reporting. After changing the seed: `pnpm seed`, delete `.next/dev/cache/fetch-cache`, restart dev. Run `pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build` (stop your dev server first). Commit in logical steps.
